grants_phd_evidence.quote: Weill Cornell Graduate School of Medical Sciences (WCGS) is a long-standing partnership between the Sloan Kettering Institute and Weill Cornell Medical College, offering doctorates in eight research programs and nine Masters programs. Additionally, WCGS offers three doctoral Tri-Institutional programs that include Rockefeller University.

programs.program_name: Computational Biology PhD (Graduate Field of Computational Biology, Ithaca)
programs.phd_evidence_quote: The graduate field of Computational Biology offers Ph.D. degrees in the development and application of data-analytical and theoretical methods, mathematical modeling and computational simulation techniques to the study of biological systems.
programs.notes: Ithaca campus. The department people page matched only Pennell and Yu; the field-faculty page lists the wider graduate-field membership.

programs.program_name: Tri-Institutional PhD Program in Computational Biology & Medicine (CBM)
programs.phd_evidence_quote: The Tri-Institutional PhD Program in Computational Biology & Medicine brings together the exceptional educational and research resources of Cornell University in Ithaca, its Medical College in New York City (Weill Cornell Medicine), Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center and The Rockefeller University.
programs.notes: Run through Weill Cornell Graduate School (WCGS), per https://gradschool.weill.cornell.edu/academics/tri-institutional-programs. Many faculty are MSK.

programs.program_name: Physiology, Biophysics, and Systems Biology (PBSB) PhD, Weill Cornell Graduate School
programs.phd_evidence_quote: Doctoral Programs at WCGS are broad and include the Biochemistry, Structural Biology, Cell Biology, Developmental Biology and Molecular Biology graduate programs collectively known as the BCMB Allied Program, Immunology and Microbial Pathogenesis, Neuroscience, Pharmacology, Physiology, Biophysics, and Systems Biology, and Population Health Sciences.
programs.notes: Evidence quote is from https://gradschool.weill.cornell.edu/academics. Pugh being listed on a WCM program page was not checked further.

programs.program_name: Tri-Institutional PhD Program in Chemical Biology (TPCB)
programs.phd_evidence_quote: The Tri-Institutional PhD Program in Chemical Biology (TPCB) at WCGS is a dynamic, interdisciplinary graduate program dedicated to understanding biological processes through the lens of chemistry.

programs.program_name: Biochemistry, Molecular and Cell Biology (BMCB) graduate field, Ithaca
programs.phd_evidence_quote: The graduate program in the Field of Biochemistry, Molecular and Cell Biology (BMCB) offers a Ph.D. degree only.
programs.notes: Evidence quote is from the BMCB student handbook page (…/bmcb-student-handbook-faculty-resources). Admissions are shared with the GGD field.

programs.program_name: Genetics, Genomics, and Development (GGD) graduate field, Ithaca
programs.phd_evidence_quote: To earn a PhD, students must complete a minimum of six academic semesters, with at least two semesters occurring after the A exam.
programs.notes: Evidence quote is from …/ggd-student-handbook-faculty-resources. The GGD faculty list looks like the same combined BMCB/GGD faculty list.

programs.phd_evidence_quote: The Department of Chemistry & Chemical Biology (C&CB) at Cornell University offers a top-ranked Ph.D. program designed to train students to become independent thinkers with specialized expertise in Chemical Sciences.

programs.program_name: Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering PhD (Smith School, Ithaca)
programs.phd_evidence_quote: Our Ph.D. program is completed in four to five years, and students typically receive full funding.
programs.notes: Included for the core-B author Fengqi You.

programs.phd_evidence_quote: Our research-oriented doctoral program gives you a deep understanding of biomedical engineering concepts and prepares you to be a world-class researcher.
programs.notes: Both the BME and CBE faculty-staff pages may be views of the shared Duffield directory (DeLisa and Varner match on both).
